description:
Manage the Master Project Schedule and Production Capacity Forecast to support the Sales Manager in business planning, assessment of new orders, and delivery commitments to customers.
1. Master Project Schedule:
• Consolidate and update project schedules from PMs; monitor contractual and forecast delivery dates.
2. Production Capacity Planning
• Track committed, available and forecast capacity across factories.
3. Sales Pipeline & Order Forecast:
• Coordinate with Sales on quotations, award probability, expected PO dates and capacity demand.
4. Delivery Commitment:
• Coordinate with Production and PMs to verify feasibility before Sales commits delivery dates
requirements_text:
- Proficient in planning software (Primavera P6, MS Project).
- Strong analytical, spatial planning (workshop allocation), and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication skills to influence and coordinate with cross-functional project managers.
- College/University degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or related fields.
- Experience: Minimum 1-2 years of experience in project planning, S&OP, or Project Portfolio Management in the Engineering & Construction (E&C), Oil & Gas, or heavy manufacturing industries.
